transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I get distracted really easily. Like, I’ll be trying to finish a dashboard, and then one Slack notification or even a song lyric or some random idea pops up, and I just… lose the thread.
Thinking back to when you were a kid, say in elementary or middle school, do you remember having similar problems staying focused or finishing tasks?

Yeah… I think so. Teachers used to write stuff like that I rushed through worksheets or didn’t follow all the directions. I remember in group work I’d talk over people sometimes.

And homework was kind of a thing—my parents would sit next to me because otherwise I’d wander off or start doing something else before I finished.
How much are these concentration problems getting in the way of you doing your job or managing day-to-day responsibilities right now?

It’s… getting in the way some. I’m not working a regular job right now, but with freelance stuff, I’ve lost a couple small contracts because I didn’t follow through cleanly enough.

And there was a portfolio competition I missed out on, basically because I couldn’t get it together on time. Some friends and people I’ve collaborated with are kind of hesitant to work with me now, even though they like my ideas.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things—like work, health, money, or relationships—on most days, even when there isn’t an immediate crisis?
I don’t think so… not most days. I mean, I worry about stuff sometimes, like anyone, but I wouldn’t say it’s this constant thing across everything.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down or sad most of the day, nearly every day?
Not really… I mean, I’ve had off days, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been sad most of the day nearly every day.
How have you been sleeping lately—do you have trouble either falling asleep or staying asleep at night?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think sleep has been the main issue… some nights are better than others, but I haven’t been tracking it or anything.
Do you often feel physically restless or like you’re driven by a motor—for example, needing to fidget, get up, or move around when you’re supposed to stay seated?

Yeah… sometimes. Like if I’m stuck on a long Zoom call or trying to work quietly in one spot, I get this kind of uncomfortable feeling, like I need to get up or pace or at least do something with my hands.
When you think about a typical week recently, how often do you have nights where it takes you a long time to fall asleep or you wake up a lot?
Um… I’m not totally sure. I haven’t really been keeping track. Some nights it feels like it takes a while, but I couldn’t say how often in a typical week.
In a usual week, how many nights would you say you have noticeable trouble either falling asleep or staying asleep?
I really don’t know… maybe a couple nights? But I’m kind of guessing. It’s not something I’ve paid that much attention to.
Do you notice these focus and follow-through problems not just with work, but also in other parts of your life, like managing things at home or in your relationships with friends or family?

Yeah… it’s not just work. It’s kind of affected other stuff too. I’ve lost some small freelance things because I didn’t follow through cleanly, and I missed a portfolio competition. And… some friends or people I’ve collaborated with seem less willing to work with me now, even if they like my ideas.
